matchup.plan_title: Plan (11:20 UTC 19 Nov): Fears went elsewhere; Murphy is back on the market
matchup.plan_md:
**Where things stand:**
- Jeremiah Fears was claimed by a team ahead of us, so our roster is unchanged.
- **Trey Murphy III** cleared waivers and is a free agent again: no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.
- **Score:** 821 to 777. **Projection with no more moves:** 1,694 to 1,683. **Adds:** 5 left.

**The plan: 5 adds, +138.2** (ESPN dates, Melbourne times). Each step has a check, with a fallback when it fails:
1. **19 Nov:** drop Bamba (no game until 20 Nov). Add **Kasparas Jakucionis** (MIL vs POR) before 12:00 PM Fri 20.
   - Only if Ryan Rollins is out again. He has missed two games with an illness ([RotoWire, 18 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/ryan-rollins-injury-ruled-out-wednesday-539783)).
   - Jakucionis scored a career-high 25 while Rollins sat ([RotoWire](https://rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/kasparas-jakucionis-news-career-night-in-losing-effort-539354)).
   - If Rollins plays, keep Bamba and skip this step.
2. **20 Nov:** drop Jakucionis after his game. Add **Murphy** before NO @OKC (12:00 PM Sat 21).
   - Only if NO's report clears him; it is due by about 10:00 AM Fri 20 Melbourne.
   - If he is out, add **Derik Queen** instead, for the same game.
3. **20 Nov:** drop Gobert after his game vs NY ends (tip-off Fri 20, 12:00 PM). Add **Quentin Grimes** (LAL) before his game vs SAC (Sat 21, 2:00 PM).
   - Only if Austin Reaves is out; *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.
   - Otherwise add **Aday Mara** before OKC vs NO (Sat 21, 12:00 PM).
4. **21 Nov:** drop Grimes or Mara after their game. Add **Neemias Queta** before BOS @SAC (Sun 22, 2:00 PM).
5. **22 Nov:** drop Murphy or Queen after their game at SA. Add **Matas Buzelis** (CHI) before his game (Mon 23, 11:00 AM).
   - If Murphy is back and playing, keeping him for the rest of the season may be worth this last add.

**Projection by outcome** (lineup over 19–22 Nov, then the final; they score 906 more):
- **Every check passes:** +138.2, about **1,832 to 1,683**.
- **Murphy out** (`--sit` Murphy 20–21 Nov): +124.1, about 1,818 to 1,683.
- **Murphy and Grimes out:** +120.4, about 1,814 to 1,683.
- **Rollins plays (step 1 skipped):** 3 adds.
  - +106.1 with Murphy: Gobert → Murphy on 20 Nov, Bamba → Queta on 21 Nov, Murphy → Buzelis on 22 Nov.
  - +92.1 without him: Queen in Murphy's place.

**Risk:** Cade Cunningham and Scottie Barnes.
- Both are *ESPN est.* 20 Nov, and Cunningham "will presumably be back" Friday ([CBS/RotoWire, 18 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pistons-cade-cunningham-ruled-out-wednesday-539841/)).
- If both miss 20 Nov and Cunningham also misses 22 Nov, about 150 comes off our side. Every line above still projects a lead.

**Form:**

| Player | Rate | Season | L7 | L15 | L30 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Kasparas Jakucionis | 31.1 | 19.9 (14) | 53.0 (2), small sample | 21.6 (7) | 19.9 (14) |
| Trey Murphy III | 35.1 | 31.0 (9) | — | 38.5 (2), small sample | 31.0 (9) |
| Matas Buzelis | 32.0 | 25.5 (14) | 38.2 (4) | 32.0 (7) | 25.5 (14) |
| Neemias Queta | 32.1 | 27.3 (14) | 38.0 (2), small sample | 30.4 (7) | 27.3 (14) |

**Why the L7s are high:**
- **Jakucionis, +33.1:** two games, a small sample, with Rollins out.
- **Buzelis, +12.8:** starting at power forward with Caleb Wilson out (*ESPN est.* 13 Dec).
- **Queta, +10.7:** two games, a small sample.
